extracted.intended_audience: freelance and professional fiction editors who write developmental editing reports/manuscript critiques
extracted.subtask_description: A template and checklist for structuring and writing developmental editing reports or manuscript critiques for novels (fiction), providing headings, prompts, and boilerplate text to streamline and standardise feedback.

rubrics_metrics.name: Structured report with relevant headings and prompts
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes a breakdown of topics to cover in your novel analysis, structured with relevant headings and prompts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The template provides section headings and prompts to guide the critic through the manuscript so the report is organised and consistent across projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comprehensive coverage of key novel areas
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure comprehensive feedback: a template helps you cover all key areas of a novel, making sure no critical aspect is overlooked in your feedback.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the included breakdown to avoid missing critical aspects of the work; completeness is presented as a core benefit of the template.

rubrics_metrics.name: Boilerplate introductions, conclusions and craft explanations
rubrics_metrics.description: Contains boilerplate text to help you with your introductions, conclusions and explanations of common craft issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pre-written text can be adapted to save time and ensure clarity when explaining common craft problems; useful for consistent, professional phrasing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clarity and client comprehension
rubrics_metrics.description: A well-structured report means your feedback is clear and easy to process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clear organisation and plain explanations help clients understand complex points, increasing the likelihood they'll respond positively and take effective action on suggestions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Actionable feedback that enables revision
rubrics_metrics.description: Feedback should help clients be more likely to be able to take effective action.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frame critiques so they lead to practical next steps; the template aims to make feedback not just evaluative but useful for revision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Professional appearance and polish
rubrics_metrics.description: Using a well-organised template gives your deliverable a polished, structured appearance, reinforcing your professionalism.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A professional-looking document signals thoughtfulness and attention to detail and supports the editor's credibility with clients.

rubrics_metrics.name: Customisability and branding (Word styles)
rubrics_metrics.description: It's easily customisable using Word’s styles, so you can add your branding at the touch of a few buttons.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Templates should be editable so editors can apply their own branding and adapt language to their voice or service offering.

rubrics_metrics.name: Efficiency / time-saving
rubrics_metrics.description: Save time: The template will streamline your critiquing process by providing a framework and jumping-off point so you don’t have to start writing and designing your document from scratch every time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the template as a starting point to reduce drafting and formatting time, enabling faster turnaround and higher throughput.

rubrics_metrics.name: Business value / profitability
rubrics_metrics.description: Increase profits: Hand-in-hand with saving time, you’ll be able to work more quickly, therefore increasing your hourly rate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A clear, comprehensive and professional report can justify higher fees and help editors feel confident charging appropriately for their services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Genre/format suitability — novels (fiction)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The template is designed specifically for novel-length fiction projects and may not be directly applicable to nonfiction, short stories, or other formats without adaptation.
